name: mmw-state-contract
description: Maintain a compact project snapshot with canonical draft and review freshness.

Follow [the current editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md). These are on-demand methods, not mandatory stages or authority over author choices. Resolve private configuration via [WORKING.md](../../../docs/configuration.md); public configuration files are templates. Use the recorded canonical draft path and revision, even where a generic filename is shown below.

# MMW state

Use [project.state.md](../../../templates/project.state.md) as the v1 shared manifest. Existing mmw.state.md may remain a compatible private summary; do not create competing sources of truth.

Record canonical_draft, draft_revision, current intent, protected author choices, selected roles, current review references, unresolved decisions and next action. Validate actual files before claiming persistence. Preserve decisions when replacing snapshots; retain detailed evidence in linked private artifacts. Never copy source conversations into public state.
